title: Price-tag app icon, Shade Cloth shows your stock, guided first sale removed
problem: The app icon predates the current art; Pak Din players choose the Shade Cloth fruit on a sheet that covers their shelf; the owner wants the guided first sale gone.
scope: The owner's price-tag icon, redrawn as a clean vector: web icons (192, 512, maskable) and the Android launcher icons
Shade Cloth: each fruit's button shows how many pieces you hold and how many spoil tonight without the cloth (or the freshest word)
The guided first sale is switched off: a first game is played by hand with the usual tips
exclusions: No rule, balance or save change

acceptance.evidence: 1301 passed, 1 skipped (as before); new tests shade-hold and the updated first-sale test

acceptance.text: The icon at every size; the Shade Cloth buttons rendered
acceptance.evidence: icon source docs/studio/icon-pricetag.svg; web 192/512/maskable and Android mipmaps regenerated; Shade Cloth buttons render counts and notes (0 none, 3 Fresh, 3 · 2 spoil)

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-24: "use this as the icon" (the price-tag design, sent as fruit-market-icon-1024.png) "but enhance", "fix Pak din players not being able to see their inventory when using their power", "remove the guided quicksale" and "push it live"

added: A new app icon: the watermelon and the price tag
changed: Shade Cloth shows what you hold of each fruit
fixed: Pak Din players can see their stock when choosing the Shade Cloth fruit
